speakingNote: I'm available for speaking at conferences, corporate events and public lectures. My talks blend research with accessible insights for diverse audiences. For booking enquiries, please contact me directly.
collaborationNote: I welcome collaboration with academics, labs and students in time perception and sensory integration. If you're interested in a collaborative project, please contact me with your CV and research interests.
contactIntro: Interested in my research? Feel free to reach out to discuss collaborations or opportunities.
